title: The Dynastic Heirs' Regatta
logline: Twin heirs race across three systems for control of a shipping trust, unaware their father's will conditions the inheritance on redeeming the company's pawned founding deed from a border union.

roles.description: The elder twin; reform-minded, determined to settle his family's historic debts and open gate lanes to working crews.
The younger twin; ruthless, proud, convinced speed and wealth entitle him to an unchecked family monopoly.
A heavy corporate cutter escorting the younger twin's racing yacht.
The family-owned freight monopoly controlling jump corridors across three systems.
The border station stevedore league that financed the founder's first hauler thirty years ago.
The ancestral shipyard station in the core system where the succession race begins.
The border system transfer hub where the founder's pawned charter pledge sits in escrow.
The corporate tribunal station in the destination system where the succession decree is registered.

public_situation: The twin heirs of {role:dynastic_freight_trust} race across three systems to claim sole inheritance under their late father's testamentary charter.
private_truth: The race is a distraction; the succession charter requires presenting the founder's original founding pledge, pawned decades ago to a border union.

beats.public_change: Regatta flags unfurl across {role:origin_station} as racing yachts power up twin drives for the inter-system dash.

missions.reason: He needs an independent pilot to mine and deliver dense structural ferrite to reinforce his yacht's bulkheads before the start.
missions.private_fact: He learned their father's will requires presenting an old pawn receipt from the border depot, and he needs heavy shielding for the detour.

beats.public_change: Both yachts jump into the border system where dockers at {role:waypoint_depot} hold the founder's original charter pledge.

missions.reason: He hires the pilot to collect the founder's original pawned charter receipt from the union vault before his twin's lawyers file a seizure.
missions.private_fact: His father pledged the founding charter thirty years ago for emergency bailout funds and hid the debt from the family for decades.

missions.reason: He asks the pilot to scan depot comms relays to prove his twin hired forged lien cancellations to erase the union's legal claim.
missions.private_fact: He promised the union steward that if he wins the succession, he will surrender the family's monopoly gate patents to the workers.

beats.public_change: {role:rival_enforcer} takes position over the jump gate approach, targeting chasing vessels to secure the younger twin's lead.

missions.reason: He needs the rival twin's armed escort disabled before its pulse cannons force his yacht out of the gate approach corridor.
missions.private_fact: The escort captain hails offering eighty thousand credits and a corporate patrol contract if the pilot hands over the pawn receipt.

beats.public_change: The yachts break out of hyperspace into {role:terminus_citadel} where corporate judges gather to certify the succession.

missions.reason: He asks the pilot to courier the founder's redeemed charter pledge and forgery logs directly to the tribunal dais.
missions.private_fact: He is terrified that honoring his father's debt will leave him with title to an impoverished and vulnerable fleet.

player_choice.prompt: The pilot arrives at the corporate citadel holding the founder's thirty-year-old pawned founding pledge.

options.label: Table the founder's pledge and inaugurate the reformer to dissolve the gate monopoly
Broker a compromise granting both twins co-directorship under union board oversight
Sell the founder's pledge to the traditionalist heir to bury the debt forever

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot delivers the founder's pledge and tables it before the tribunal.
resolutions.summary: {role:reformer_heir} takes control of {role:dynastic_freight_trust} and honors the pledge, dissolving gate monopolies for {role:independent_dockers_union}.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot carried the founder's thirty-year-old pawn ticket to the tribunal, breaking the family gate monopoly.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot brokers a shared settlement conditioning succession on union board seats.
resolutions.summary: A compromise divides the directorship. {role:independent_dockers_union} gains board oversight in exchange for retiring the founder's debt.

resolutions.reached_by: The pledge is sold or destroyed, or the traditionalist heir registers the winning run unopposed.
resolutions.summary: {role:traditionalist_heir} registers his arrival unopposed and burns the debt. {role:dynastic_freight_trust} doubles its freight tariffs across three systems.

loose_threads.detail: An escrow ticket in the depot vault records the founder's charter pawned thirty years ago to cover an unlisted private debt.
The rival escort cutter's hull plates bear serial stencils matching a security firm that was liquidated eight months ago.
A destination gate exchange posted new transit surcharges two hours before the founder's death was officially announced.

radio_hooks: Corporate media feeds broadcast real-time telemetry from dynastic succession regatta.
Independent dockers union holds quiet vigil at border transit depot.
Tribunal registers heavy betting on upcoming family trust succession decree.

voice_direction.reformer_heir: Intense, articulate, and driven. Speaks with aristocratic polish but peppers his speech with egalitarian political theory and hatred of monopolies.
voice_direction.traditionalist_heir: Arrogant, dismissive, and icy. Treats multi-system trade networks like private family property and views independent pilots as trespassers.
